claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Ohio EPA 的最終許可或 Will-Power 之後的申請把 line heaters 拿掉，或其他表後燃氣電廠許可普遍沒有燃料加熱／調壓設備。核查頻率：每半年（新的表後電廠許可）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀這一層是不是表後燃氣電廠的必要單元。
claims.statement: Ohio EPA hearing deck (2026-04-08) for Will-Power OH LLC's Apollo behind-the-meter power station in Bowling Green, Ohio (power for a co-located customer): 6 natural-gas RICE generators, 21 natural-gas turbine generators, 2 diesel emergency engines and 22 line heaters — fuel-gas line heating is a listed unit of a behind-the-meter gas plant. The deck names no equipment suppliers and does not name the co-located customer.
